<a id="menu_charset_script"></a>
### [`menu_charset_script`](../../../../src/script/menu_charset.asm#L6) `$1EF8-$1EFD`

*data*

Script: copies the second character set of the character ROM ($d800, 2048 bytes) to $5000, then puts the menu graphics into characters $5e-$f1: frame lines, tool icons and colour cells.
